summary: Adult male hiker collapsed on the Ruby Anthracite trail about 2.5 miles up while hiking with a partner; the partner attempted lifesaving efforts, then hiked out and drove to cell coverage to call for help; Crested Butte Search and Rescue hiked in with a wheel and litter to recover the deceased hiker
notes: Separate incident reported in the same CBN article; cause of collapse not reported.
